name: supply-sophie-unanswered-round
narrative: Sophie runs RUTF procurement for the Connect-RUTF program. 17 days ago she asked six suppliers to quote round 2: half have never answered, despite two reminders, and she forwards whatever does arrive to an AI that records it. Sophie opens round 2 and reads who answered and who has said nothing, how long each has been silent and when she last chased them, and that the round has not yet settled how import duties are handled. She opens the reminder drafted for Sahel, which says when Sahel was asked and last reminded, and records today's chase from the draft itself. Sahel answers with a quote; Sophie forwards it, and in the round's history, turned to replies only, Sahel's email comes first: she opens it beside what the AI recorded from it, the reply dated the day it came in. On the comparison none of the three quotes can be compared yet, and the round's own decision comes first: Harmattan's carriage-paid and Sahel's ex-works terms both make the import ours, so their duty waits on the round's unsettled duty terms, whatever figure a supplier wrote; Kanem's has not stated how many sachets are in a carton, and Sahel's gives no freight figure and its price is in euros, with no exchange rate recorded yet. Northgate's questions are waiting on her, and she answers the one about who imports: we import, under the program's duty waiver. She marks that answer as the round's import duty terms and opens the comparison again: duty now reads waived on every quote that leaves the import to us, Harmattan's quote has the round's first landed total, and Sahel's reads duty waived, the round's terms set from her answer to Northgate, while Kanem's delivered-duty-paid quote keeps its own duty. Importing makes the paperwork hers, and round 1 shows what that means: its 2,000 cartons are still not in Kano, and the order with Harmattan reads as waiting on us: what we owe the forwarder lists the import permit and the customs declaration, the forwarder's message says the trucks are held at the border on our import permit, and Harmattan's invoice is flagged above the agreed price, billed against agreed. Back on her overview, after the chain's counts of where every record sits, Sophie reads who is still silent, Sahel's quote now short only its exchange rate and freight, its duty covered by the waiver, and whose move each thing is: six moves are hers, among them the round 1 order's import permit and the dispute of Harmattan's invoice above the agreed price, against two suppliers who are silent.

sophie.intro: Sophie buys RUTF for the Connect-RUTF program; suppliers and the freight forwarder email her, and she forwards what they send to an AI that records it.

scenes.narrative: Sophie asked six suppliers to quote round 2; only three of the six have replied, though she chased the others twice. She opens the round and reads who answered and who is silent, how long each has been silent and when she last chased them, and that the round has not settled how import duties are handled. She wants the record to keep telling her the truth: what the answers left out, and whose move it is.
scenes.title: Half the round never answered

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the round's draft emails and reads the reminder drafted for Sahel: it says when Sahel was asked and when she last reminded them, and under the message the Chased on field already holds today's date beside Record chase, so the chase she sends is recorded from the draft itself. Back on the Outreach table, Sahel's row is highlighted: last chased today, the third reminder.
scenes.title: She chases Sahel from a drafted reminder

scenes.narrative: Sahel answers the reminder with a quote and Sophie forwards it to the AI. She lands on the round's history, turned to replies only, where Sahel's email comes first. scenes.title: Sahel finally answers, and she opens the email

features.description: The comparison page compares no quote on landed total while the round's duty terms are unsettled, says the round's own duty terms come first, and names what each supplier still owes: sachets per carton on Kanem's; the freight amount on Sahel's, whose price is in euros, with no exchange rate recorded yet.

features.description: A status chip at the top of the comparison states the round's import duty terms; while they are not settled, every quote whose Incoterm leaves the import to us carries the same Duty line and the same round-owned blocker, whatever duty figure its supplier stated.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=comparison-duty-terms] reads 'Import duties for this round: not settled'; Harmattan Therapeutics' and Sahel Nutrition Industries' [data-testid=card-duty] both read 'Duty: ours to cost (round terms not settled)', each card lists 'Import duty is ours to cost and the round's duty terms are not settled' with 'Ours to do: settle the round's duty terms (not asked of the supplier)', and no page text reads 'excluded from the price, stated as'

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the comparison: none of the three quotes can be compared yet, and the first thing in the way is the round's own decision. Harmattan quotes carriage paid to Kano and Sahel quotes ex works, so on both the import is ours: their duty is ours to cost and waits on the round's unsettled duty terms, whatever duty figure a supplier wrote, never on a question to them, so Harmattan's, held by nothing else, sits under the round's decision apart from the suppliers who still owe a fact. What the suppliers still owe is named on each card: Kanem has not stated how many sachets are in a carton, and Sahel's new quote gives no freight figure; its price is in euros, per carton as well as per sachet, with no exchange rate recorded yet to put it in dollars.
scenes.title: No quote can be compared until the round decides

features.description: After the answer sets the round's duty terms, the comparison's duty terms note reads the waiver, and every quote whose Incoterm leaves the import to us has its duty settled: Harmattan's quote has the round's first landed total, with its duty waived, and Sahel's Duty line reads waived (our import), citing the answer that set the round's terms, with duty no longer among its blockers.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=comparison-duty-terms] contains 'we import, under the program's duty waiver'; the banner reads '1 of 3 quotes can be compared'; Harmattan Therapeutics is under Comparable and its [data-testid=landed-duty] reads 'duty waived (our import)'; Sahel Nutrition Industries' Needs info card [data-testid=card-duty] contains 'Duty: waived (our import)' and its [data-testid=card-duty-provenance] contains 'from your answer to Northgate Commodities', and no card's blockers include 'Import duty is ours to cost'

scenes.narrative: Back on the round, Sophie answers Northgate's question about who imports, for her reply to Northgate: we import, under the program's duty waiver. She marks that answer as setting the round's import duty terms, then opens the round's comparison again: duty now reads waived (our import) on every quote that leaves the import to us, so Harmattan's quote has the round's first landed total, its price and freight with duty waived, and Sahel's reads duty waived, the round's terms set from her answer to Northgate, with only its exchange rate and freight left; Kanem's delivered-duty-paid quote, where the supplier imports, keeps its own duty.
scenes.title: One answer to Northgate settles how duty is costed

scenes.narrative: Back on her overview, Sophie reads who is still silent, what each quote still lacks and whose move each thing is. Below, the chain counts where every record sits; back at the top, round 2 is waiting on two suppliers who have not replied and on her: answers to Northgate's questions, extending or closing the round, and attaching the waiver document that covers Sahel's duty, Sahel's quote now short only its exchange rate and freight; and the round 1 order is waiting on her to provide the customs declaration and the import permit and to dispute Harmattan's invoice above the agreed price. Six moves are hers, against two suppliers who are silent.
scenes.title: Who is silent, and whose move each thing is
